'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Good day, young man. As a doctor, I think that the Hippocratic oath must be respected even in such a difficult time. So, I have got an idea to open a clinic. Health care is always important and even more so in these circumstances. But where do I get the necessary equipment?  I will give you a list of what I need you to bring. And I don't need competition, so make sure you complete the job with no third parties involved. Of course, I will find a way to reward you for your work.}}

==Requirements==
* Must be level 35 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Find 1 [[Ophthalmoscope]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 1 [[LEDX Skin Transilluminator]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
*Hand over the 1 [[Ophthalmoscope]]
*Hand over the 1 [[LEDX Skin Transilluminator]]

==Rewards==
* +30,600 [[EXP]]
*[[Therapist]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.05'''</font>
* 130,000 Roubles
** 136,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
** 149,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 3
* 1× [[T H I C C item case]]
* 1× [[Health Resort east wing room 306 key]]
{{quote|Did you bring it? Great, put it all down there in the corner. Careful, the equipment is very fragile.  Even if the whole clinic thing fails, I know some people who may be interested in this equipment, but that’s between you and me. Why waste such expensive hardware?}}
